verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-definable rules or automation builder that triggers actions on events, and it shows no webhooks or event subscriptions in the API or MCP docs. The closest items are call-routing features (ring orders, phone menus, routing incoming calls) and the Sona AI answering agent. These are fixed call-handling features, not general event-triggered automation rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
